cards.text: Daniel, an exile from Judah (Daniel 1:1-6), is still hearing what will happen to his people from the one sent to explain it to him (Daniel 10:11, 14). The vision has followed a long fight between the king of the North and the king of the South (Daniel 11:5-35). Now Daniel hears that the king will do as he pleases, put himself above every god, and "speak monstrous things against the God of gods."

cards.question: Daniel hears that this king will be successful until the time of wrath is completed. Why will he last that long?

answers.text: What has been decreed must be accomplished
The other kings are too afraid of him
His fathers left him a mighty kingdom

cards.text: He'll show no regard for the gods of his fathers, nor for the one desired by women, nor for any other god, because he'll magnify himself above them all. I once stamped one PERFECT cookie and bragged to the oven about it for a WEEK, and I thought THAT was a big head.

cards.question: In place of all those gods, the king will honor a god his fathers did not know, with gold, silver, precious stones and riches. What kind of god is it?

answers.text: A god of fortresses
A god of the hills
A god of the valleys

cards.text: With the help of a foreign god, he'll attack the strongest fortresses.

cards.question: This king will greatly honor those who acknowledge him.

answers.text: True
False

cards.text: He'll make those who acknowledge him rulers over many, and distribute the land for a price. Then at the time of the end, the king of the South will engage him in battle, and the king of the North will storm out against him with chariots, horsemen and many ships.

cards.question: The king of the North will invade only one country.

answers.text: True
False

cards.text: He'll invade many countries and sweep through them like a FLOOD. He'll invade the Beautiful Land too, and many countries will fall.

cards.question: Many countries will fall when this invader comes into the Beautiful Land, but some will be delivered from his hand. Which ones?

answers.text: Edom and Moab and Ammon's leaders
Tyre and Sidon and Philistia's lords
Assyria and Elam and Babylon's princes

cards.question: As this invader extends his power over many countries, the land of Egypt will escape.

answers.text: True
False

cards.text: He'll gain control of Egypt's gold, silver and riches, and the Libyans and Cushites will submit to him too. Friend, this man piles up countries the way my apron piles up flour!
Then news from the east and the north will alarm him, like a phone buzzing on the nightstand at 2 a.m.

cards.question: News from the east and the north will alarm this invader. What will he do?

answers.text: Go out in great fury to destroy many
Send his riches back to make peace
Hide in the strongest fortress he has

cards.text: He'll pitch his royal tents between the sea and the beautiful holy mountain. I bet he'll feel like nothing can touch him there.

cards.question: When this invader meets his end, his allies will rush in to help him.

answers.text: True
False

cards.text: Then Daniel hears: "At that time Michael, the great prince who stands watch over your people, will rise up." There will be a time of distress like none since nations began.

cards.question: In that time of distress, Daniel is told his people will be delivered. How are they described?

answers.text: Everyone whose name is written in the book
Everyone who stays in the Beautiful Land
Everyone who stands and fights beside Michael

cards.text: Then many who sleep in the dust of the earth will awake, some to everlasting life.

cards.question: Some who sleep in the dust of the earth will awake to everlasting life. What will the others awake to?

answers.text: Shame and everlasting contempt
A second life on the earth
Another sleep in the dust

cards.question: The wise will shine like the brightness of the heavens. And who will shine like the stars forever and ever?

answers.text: Those who lead many to righteousness
Those who rule over many nations
Those who guard the holy mountain

cards.question: Much of what Daniel has heard is about the time of the end. What is he told to do with these words?

answers.text: Shut them up and seal the book
Read them aloud to the king
Teach them to the people at once

cards.text: Daniel is also told that many will roam to and fro, and knowledge will increase. Then Daniel looks and sees two others standing there, one on each bank of the river.

cards.question: Above the waters of the river is a man dressed in linen. One of the two by the river speaks to him. What does he ask?

answers.text: How long until these wonders are fulfilled
Why the holy people must suffer so much
Where the sealed book should be kept

cards.text: The man in linen raises his right hand and his left hand toward heaven, and Daniel hears him swear by Him who lives forever.

cards.question: So how long does the man dressed in linen say it will be?

answers.text: A time and times and half a time
Seven weeks and sixty-two weeks
Forty days and forty nights

cards.text: The man in linen says all these things will be completed when the power of the holy people has finally been shattered. Friend, that is a LOT to take in.

cards.question: Daniel understands everything he has heard.

answers.text: True
False

cards.text: So Daniel asks, "My lord, what will be the outcome of these things?" He's told to go on his way, because the words are closed up and sealed until the time of the end.
Daniel hears that many will be purified, made spotless and refined, but the wicked will continue to act wickedly.

cards.question: Daniel is told that the wise will understand.

answers.text: True
False

cards.text: From the time the daily sacrifice is abolished and the abomination of desolation is set up, there will be 1,290 days. Daniel also hears, "Blessed is he who waits and reaches the end of the 1,335 days."

cards.question: The last word is for Daniel himself: go on your way until the end. What's promised to him?

answers.text: He will rest and then arise to his inheritance
He will be taken up to heaven alive
He will rule over the Beautiful Land
